note: Native ports that come with an installer of their own, which MacGameFix downloads, checks and opens (app/NativeInstallers.swift). Each entry names one published file by its SHA-256 and size: the installer is not notarized, so MacGameFix opens that file and no other. A new release of a port reaches players when its entry here is changed. steamApp is the Windows game's Steam app id; app is what the installer leaves in Applications, and bundle a part of that app's bundle identifier, which tells it from another application of the same name (Steam leaves a shortcut called after the game in the same folder); installer is the application inside the disk image.
